Q6113.reason: Inadvertently leaving the stove on is negligence, not the recklessness that supplies malice for arson, so he is not guilty of that felony.

Q5966.reason: The three-phase model names the cycle systole, diastole, and rest; contraction and relaxation only describe the first two phases.

Q8294.reason: The negative solid-liquid slope exists because ice is less dense than liquid water; a denser solid would slope the other way.
